name: Encode Packaging India Limited
about: Encode Packaging India Limited engages in the designing, branding, and printing business in India. It offers self-adhesive labels, printed labels, clampshell cards, belly bands, mono cartons, and hang and swing tags. The company also provides graphic design services, including marketing collaterals, brochures, and catalogues, etc. It serves the automotive, FMCG, home appliance, construction, power tool, and trademark industries. The company was formerly known as Nova Publications India Limited and changed its name to Encode Packaging India Limited in February 2022. Encode Packaging India Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
